newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil steady.

text.p: European low sulphur straight-run was steady on Tuesday, with buyers and sellers still far apart with neither pressured to act, traders said.
Sellers of 0.5-0.7 pct sulphur material were in the three figure zone, $100 to $102 fob, while buyers were in the high nineties, $97/$98, steady to a touch lower than Monday.
"Three figures starting at $100 would be ok for me," one seller said. "But buyers and sellers are still far apart, there's no pressure."
Traders said that sellers have increased their asking price a little on the back of crude's gains on Monday.
High sulphur Russian straight-run was still on offer at steady prices, with a few M-100 cargoes at two means plus $3, traders said.
